original_test_intent: Verify the Internal Reference Designator string in every SMBIOS Type 8 record identifies the approved internal board-side port/connector and remains bound to the same internal type, external designator/type and port type after reboot. The source tests firmware metadata, not a physical label inspection.
original_method: Capture complete raw/decoded Type 8 structures, retain the internal designator string index/value with handle and all paired connector fields, compare the record set to the approved board/port map, reboot and repeat; keep any separately requested visual label audit outside this metadata verdict.
manual_activity: A user approves the board/port metadata map, normalization and reboot plan. No physical connector action is inherent; an independently required visual label audit remains manual and separately evidenced.
required_inputs: Expected internal designator per Type 8 record/port
Approved board revision and port/connector map
Normalization and allowed blank/duplicate designator rules
Expected internal/external connector types and port type for record disambiguation
Validated Type 8 parser plus approved reboot and OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only; do not plug/unplug, probe or energize connectors and do not modify firmware.
Preserve raw string index/value, handle and all Type 8 connector/port fields; a grep fragment can misassociate repeated designators.
Do not claim physical silk-screen or wiring correctness from SMBIOS metadata alone.
Do not infer internal connector identity solely from the designator text when the paired enum fields disagree.
Stop on malformed strings, duplicate ambiguous records, map mismatch, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete Type 8 records, resolve internal designators, compare full connector-pair identities with the approved board map before/after reboot.
Do not manipulate connectors, substitute visual inspection or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve metadata designator/connector map and normalization policy.
If physical label correctness is additionally required, arrange separate human evidence; approve reboot/recovery and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is correct, but grep loses handle and adjacent internal/external type and port fields, so repeated text cannot be mapped reliably.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 8 structures and compare each resolved internal designator together with both connector types, external designator and port type against the board map.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Internal Reference Designator scope, Type 8 script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Resolve the internal designator string for every Type 8 handle, retain full paired connector/port context and compare the ordered or identity-keyed record set to the approved board map before and after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS, board revision and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 8 Internal Reference Designator and connector/port semantics, approved platform board/port map and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw string provenance and complete record identity while keeping physical inspection outside source scope.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; prevents duplicate/misbound designators from passing and avoids unsupported hardware claims.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Board/Type 8 record map and normalization policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Firmware metadata can be correct while a physical label or cable is wrong; that requires a separately scoped manual audit.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve vendor-specific naming aliases or blank internal designators for defined ports, but must identify the full Type 8 record and must not turn optional physical inspection into a change of automation class for this metadata core.
expected_evidence: Approved board revision, Type 8 designator/connector map, normalization and tool versions
Complete pre-reboot Type 8 table with handle, raw string index/value, internal/external connector types/designators and port type
Record-level map comparison with duplicates/blank handling
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot comparison
Engineer verdict; any visual label evidence separately identified and not claimed by the agent
